payload.blocks: Phase 1 of plan 261119-1142-supervisor-live-run cannot start a unit; the plan stays running with phase 1 ready.
payload.headline: fgos run from a lead is refused: prompt not seen after --json

parts.cause: The request route rewrites argv to `run --json <prompt> --writes ...` in both cases (tickets c-3461-1795077411252, c-3733-1795077418762), and the host does not see the prompt. Likely the route or the parser, unproven. The worktree /home/vantt/projects/forgent-worktrees/261119-1142-supervisor-live-run-p01 (branch supervisor-live-run/p01) exists and is unused. The plan status and lead role landed (mainSha 750471a9).

options.cost: One fix outside this plan, then one rerun.
options.does: Someone fixes how a lead's `fgos run <prompt>` is passed through the request socket, then I rerun the same call.
options.gain: The lead path the live run is meant to prove works as designed.
options.harm: Needs an owner or supervisor change outside this plan footprint.
options.label: Fix the route

options.cost: One plan-directory file plus one land.
options.does: I write a unit file in the plan directory and run `fgos run --unit <file>`.
options.gain: May get past the prompt parsing without any code change.
options.harm: Hides the prompt bug the live run exists to find; I do not know the unit file format.
options.label: Use --unit file

options.cost: One land of the plan file.
options.does: Mark phase 1 parked with this reason and stop.
options.harm: The live run does not complete.
options.label: Park the plan

parts.recommendation: Fix the route (first option): the throwaway plan exists to expose exactly this kind of gap, so reporting it is the result.

scope.allows: A fix of the request-socket run path outside this plan, or an owner-approved --unit workaround; I rerun phase 1 afterward.
scope.forbids: I will not write outside plan 261119-1142-supervisor-live-run, run the unit myself with Bash, or start or stop any session.

parts.what: Phase 1 (write one scratch file) cannot run. Both `fgos run --provider gemini --capability execute --worktree <p01> --writes <file> "<prompt>"` calls, with the prompt first and last among the flags, failed with exit 4: `fgos run requires --unit <file|-> or --resume <unitRunId>, a "<prompt>", or --sync <ref>`.
